तिम् {vI.v} {c1c} P. (तेमति, तिमित) To
make wet or damp, moisten. {vII.v}
{c4c} P. (तिम्यति)
1 To become wet.
--2
To become quiet or tranquil, be
calm.

तीम् {c4c} P. (तीम्यति) To be wet
or moist.

तिमित a. [तिम्-कर्तरि-क्त]
1 Moist,
wet, damp.
--2 Motionless, steady.
--3 Calm, tranquil.

1 The ocean.
--2 A kind
of whale or fish of an enormous
size;

.
--3 A fish in
general.
--4 The figure of a fish
produced by drawing two lines, one
intersecting the other at right angles.
--Comp.
--कोषः the ocean.
--जं a
kind of pearl.
--ध्वजः N. of a
demon killed by Indra with the
assistance of Daśaratha. (It was
in the fight with this demon that
Kaikeyī saved the life of Daśaratha
while in a swooning fit and got
from him two boons which she
afterwards used to send Rāma into exile).

तिमिंगिलः A kind of fish which
swallows a timi;

. ˚अशनः,
˚गिलः a very large fish which
swallows even a timingila;
तिमिंगिलगिलोऽप्यस्ति तद्गिलोऽप्यस्ति राघवः ।.

तिमिर a. [तिम्-किरच्] Dark;
विन्यस्यंतीं दृशौ तिमिरे पथि

; Śi. 4. 57.
--2 Blindness.
--3 Iron-rust.
--Comp.
--अरिः, --नुद्
m.,
--रिपुः the sun.

1 An epithet of Rāhu.
--2 An eclipse in general.

तिमिरयति Den. P. To obscure,
eclipse, darken.

तिमिरायते Den. A. To be or appear
dark.
